brand.name: CoreMeet
brand.tagline: Secure, instant video meetings in your browser. Built with WebRTC.

hero.lead: CoreMeet is a clean, fast place to meet. Create a room, share the code, and everyone is talking face to face — no downloads, no friction.

logos.heading: Teams keep their conversations moving with CoreMeet

highlights.title: Everything a call needs. Nothing it doesn't.

items.title: Everyone in the room, in crisp HD
items.text: Peer-to-peer WebRTC keeps latency low and your conversation private. The tile grid adapts as people come and go, with an active-speaker view when it gets busy.
points: Up to 8 people in a mesh call
Mic & camera state you can see at a glance

items.title: Share your screen — it takes the stage
items.text: Start presenting and your screen fills the room while everyone else slides into a neat side rail. Swap between a tab, a window, or the whole display without dropping the call.
points: Others stay visible in the rail

items.title: Talk on the side, without leaving
items.text: Send links and notes in the in-call chat, see exactly who's connected, and let the host admit or remove people. Everything is right where you expect it.

security.title: Your meeting is safe.
security.text: No one joins a room unless the host lets them in, and your audio and video travel directly between participants.
points: Peer-to-peer media — the server never sees your call
Unique room codes, host admits guests
Rotating refresh tokens, hashed at rest
Rooms end when the host ends them

items.q: Do I need an account to join a meeting?
items.a: No. Anyone with the link can join — you just pick a name and set your camera and mic on the way in. An account is only needed to create a meeting.

items.q: How many people can be in a call?
items.a: CoreMeet uses a peer-to-peer mesh, which is great for small groups — comfortably up to around 8 people. Larger rooms are on the roadmap.
Yes. Creating and joining meetings is free, with no time limit and no credit card.
Straight between participants over WebRTC. The server only helps set up the connection and relays chat and presence.
Any modern browser — Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari — on desktop or mobile. Nothing to install.
